lines.3: 「They call it the Seven-Color Rice-Ball Set.」
lines.5: That made five rice-ball meals in a row...
lines.6: 「Leo, are you going to the Princess fan club meeting today?」
lines.8: 「If they find out I joined the student council, their combined jealousy might kill me.」
lines.9: 「Apparently, even people who wanted to join got rejected one after another in their interviews with the Princess.」
lines.11: 「Knowing the capricious Princess, she could suddenly decide to fire us.」
lines.12: 「Until we're sure of our positions, we should avoid carelessly telling anyone.」
lines.13: 「Yeah... It'd be embarrassing if we told everybody we joined and then got fired.」
lines.14: 「The scary thing is, the Princess might look us straight in the eye and ask, 'Huh? Did I really say that yesterday?'」
lines.15: 「Right. Let's wait and see a little longer.」
lines.16: 「If we go to the fan club, we might accidentally let something slip.」
